title: TradingHubAssociation
description: Links a trading hub to one associated entity. One record per (hub, member) pair. `entity_id` may name a bus (hub membership) or a market transaction settling at the hub, resolved through the entity registry, so no member-type discriminator is needed — the same shape as ServiceAssociation.

trading_hub_id.description: ID of the trading hub the association belongs to.

entity_id.description: ID of the associated entity: a bus or a market transaction.
